intro: Our Aero bedside is designed to keep your space peaceful and organised. With soft-close storage and a sleek design, it ensures everything you need is always within reach—without the clutter.

features.title: Make the most of your space with ease
features.text: Need more bedside storage? This compact table keeps your essentials close without crowding your room—because staying organised should be effortless.

features.title: Sturdy build you can count on every day
features.text: Enjoy peace of mind with thick PLT panels that provide long-lasting strength and resilience, even in your home’s busiest spaces.

features.title: Drawers that glide smoothly and quietly
features.text: Experience effortless organisation with premium Hettich Quadro slides that ensure smooth, quiet drawer operation every time.

features.title: Sleek drawers for a stylish, modern look
features.text: With its sleek, glossy finish, our furniture doesn’t just perform—it brings a touch of contemporary elegance that brightens up any space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
